# Test extension `agent-tools` (spec 018, research R13)

The extension the agent calls in the quickstart and the e2e scene `extension-agent-tools`. Its bundle
`../agent-tools.xt` is built and signed by `tests/extension_e2e_fixtures.rs` with the fixtures' test key.

| File            | Role                                                                          |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `manifest.json` | The manifest, `tools` included; read by the Rust builder and bundled into JS  |
| `main.js`       | Registers the tools with `sdk.tools`                                          |
| `index.html`    | Entry page                                                                    |
| `app.js`        | Generated by `build.sh`: `main.js` bundled with the released SDK, do not edit |

`app.js` contains, bundled with esbuild 0.28.2 (from holzi's `node_modules`), unchanged:

- `@haex-space/vault-sdk` 4.3.0, npm tarball integrity
  `sha512-x9pzz2EhA5XaLply/Sr2ENzlRQ6hUx3Y5rLpyP5Vj6Z6bfw5XUc/mMA/R8RkQ4RhWocnfP0wlXTmPt/37oWTMg==`
  (source: haex-space/vault-sdk, release of PR #64, merge `280cebf63eba72422d1ddd62e1edeb5ad7e7d3cc`)
- `drizzle-orm` 0.45.4, a dependency of the SDK

`build.sh` checks the SDK's integrity and builds the same bytes on every run. After a change:

```sh
src-tauri/tests/fixtures/extension_e2e/agent-tools/build.sh
HOLZI_WRITE_E2E_FIXTURES=1 cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test extension_e2e_fixtures
```
